answer: A validator grove of n nodes tolerating f Byzantine faults under n ≥ 3f+1 forces every 2f+1 quorum to overlap any peer in ≥ f+1 slots. Two disjoint quorums need 4f+2 > n, so an adversary owning f nodes can never seat both, making malicious intersection impossible. Bond each entrant with collateral C, slashing equivocation proportionally, so a sonnet-metered zero-knowledge attestation makes forged state-machine commits non-repudiable. Since slashed stake S exceeds any plume of extractable rewrite value V, E[U]=V−S<0, so honest replication is a strict Nash equilibrium.
